angles: The real cost isn't the model — it's everything around it: orchestration, integrations, memory, and evaluation infrastructure
POC-first strategy: validate with a $2K-$5K proof of concept before committing six figures to production build
Hidden costs that blow budgets: data prep (50-70% of time), integration maintenance, monitoring, retraining, compliance updates
Team location arbitrage: Eastern European teams deliver same quality at 50-70% lower cost than US equivalents
The 5-10x complexity jump: moving from single-agent to multi-agent isn't 2x the cost — it's often 5-10x
Right-sizing models: 80% of work on cheaper models, only hard decisions routed to flagship LLMs — cuts API costs 60-70%
Industry compliance premium: Healthcare adds 25-40%, Fintech adds 15-30% to baseline costs
Build vs buy decision: off-the-shelf solutions $50-$500/mo per user but limit customization; custom builds $5K-$200K+ but give full control
The evaluation paradox: spending $10K on proper evaluation saves $50K on production debugging
Year 1 total cost of ownership: budget 20-30% on top of build cost for operations, API costs, and maintenance
